title: Right-sizing
intro: Requests and limits against real usage, with a recommendation per container. Nothing is changed in the cluster: copy the snippet into your manifests.

source.history: Usage from Prometheus over {{window}}: CPU at the 95th percentile and its peak, memory at its peak.
source.snapshot: Only current values are available (a snapshot from {{source}}). A single point is not enough for a recommendation: install Prometheus for history.
source.snapshotAfterError: Prometheus history could not be read, so only current values are shown (a snapshot). No recommendations.
source.none: No metrics are available: only requests and limits from the pod specs are checked.
source.historyFailed: Prometheus history could not be read
source.truncated_one: Too many containers matched; only the first {{count}} has history. Narrow the namespace filter.
source.truncated_other: Too many containers matched; only the first {{count}} have history. Narrow the namespace filter.
source.coverageUnknown: Prometheus could not say since when it has samples, so how much history the recommendations rest on is unknown.

tooMany_one: Only the first {{count}} row is shown. Narrow the namespace filter.
tooMany_other: Only the first {{count}} rows are shown. Narrow the namespace filter.
totals: Wasted: {{cpu}} CPU, {{memory}} memory · Requested: {{requestedCpu}} CPU, {{requestedMemory}} memory

confidence.insufficientHistory: Not enough history: {{duration}} of {{window}}, at least {{minimum}} is needed

flagHints.noCpuRequest: The scheduler reserves no CPU for this container.
flagHints.noMemoryRequest: The scheduler reserves no memory; the pod is among the first evicted under memory pressure.
flagHints.noCpuLimit: The container may use any idle CPU of the node. Often intended.
flagHints.noMemoryLimit: The container may take memory from its neighbours on the node.
flagHints.cpuOverProvisioned: The CPU request is at least {{factor}} times what the usage needs.
flagHints.memoryOverProvisioned: The memory request is at least {{factor}} times what the usage needs.
flagHints.cpuUnderRequested: Usage is above the request most of the time.
flagHints.memoryUnderRequested: Peak memory is above the request: the pod can be evicted under memory pressure.
flagHints.memoryNearLimit: Memory reached at least {{share}} of the limit.
flagHints.oomKilled: The container was killed for running out of memory in the last {{period}}; the real peak is above the limit.

chooseNamespaceText: Right-sizing reads the history of every container it shows, so it works on the namespaces chosen in the namespace filter. Pick one or a few.
firstNamespaces_one: Only the first {{count}} namespace of the filter is shown.
firstNamespaces_other: Only the first {{count}} namespaces of the filter are shown.
